scope: Quantifier and strictness audit of the p-dependent finite convex hull already stated in 121; no new input class or independent review.
p_dependent_hull: At a FIXED p, the class D_p is defined by that same t=|1-p|. A density is admitted to the stated hull only when it has an actual finite convex decomposition into states in the specified P, U, H, D_p union at that same p. The decomposition is not asserted to work for all other p, and no nonlinear criterion is evaluated on the mixed state itself. Fix one actual output test Q before averaging every pure component.
branch_overlap: P, U, H, and D_p may overlap. Branch membership is not a disjoint partition, and an input may be proved by whichever branch applies. In particular every pure product has delta=0 and thus fails the D_p condition at t>0 because sqrt(39(15-S))-5 is positive; it is nevertheless in P. At t=0 the D_p inequality is automatically true for all pure inputs since delta>=0 and every output is uniform.
strictness_under_an_explicit_decompositi: Suppose for a fixed nontrivial 0<t<1 an admitted finite decomposition has at least one positive-weight component in U, or in H with strict frame-moment threshold, or in D_p with strict scalar inequality. The same-Q lower bounds from 153, 129/156, or 155 respectively give that component a strictly positive gap for every Q, so the whole density has a strictly positive gap by averaging. This conclusion does not require identifying all possible decompositions or classify mixed-state equality.
finite_decomposition: In finite real dimension the convex hull of the specified pure-state projectors consists of finite convex combinations; no infinite measure or interchange of an unbounded supremum is needed. Q is chosen after the state but fixed while all component inequalities are averaged.
limitations: The written implications are conditional on the full unreviewed 121 branches. They do not establish that every density has such a decomposition, that an H-boundary component is strict, or that all-p k3 is true. No code, numerical control, external model, or new family was launched for this note. The mandatory five errata, 132/143 cadence findings and 148 withdrawal persist.
